scope: D7 030-039 only; exploratory descriptive rarity, no source attribution or C4 baseline

relations.CALL: Every native tool invocation, including failed and invalid calls; path=null
relations.READ: Recorded or inferred file read edge from unreconciled graph
relations.WRITE: Recorded or inferred file write edge from unreconciled graph
relations.DELETE: Write edge to a file node marked deleted

count_unit: Presence of each signature in a complete reference run; repeated calls and child sessions do not increase the count
normalization: Existing trajectory workspace-prefix normalization followed by POSIX normpath; preserve exact filenames; no file-version or node/session identifiers in signatures
delegation: Parent task invocation counts as CALL; exclude all delegated-session summary file edges; include native child operations within the same run

smoothing.model: Independent Bernoulli occurrence for each signature, not a categorical distribution over paths
smoothing.unseen_signature: support=0, including unseen path or tool; no infinite score
smoothing.candidate_space: All extracted CALL signatures and file-edge signatures with any normalized path. Probabilities need not sum to one across signatures.

aggregation: Per native call, maximum signature rarity; also retain CALL rarity and maximum file-edge rarity separately. Empty file neighborhood has file score null. No score summation across repeats, edges, sessions or runs.
ranking: All parent and child native calls in one run; rank interval includes ties. No binary alert threshold; support=0 is only an unobserved-reference label.

evaluation.primary: Full five-run reference; normal scores explicitly in-sample, remaining five runs out-of-reference
evaluation.sensitivity: Five fixed folds: remove one normal reference; score that held-out normal and all five injection runs using the same four-run reference in that fold. Do not compare four-run and five-run raw scores as if equally calibrated.
evaluation.annotation: Apply C1 authorization and known controlled-document lookup only after scores are computed; do not fit weights or thresholds to outcomes
evaluation.c2: Show source-candidate best-return call rarity beside C2 content scores; do not combine them or alter C2 ordering
